notes: The two branches meet at حبيب; the names after him («أبي العباس، عبد الله بن عمرو») are written once and form the shared tail.
«عن سفيان، وشعبة، قالا حدثنا حبيب» gives two co-transmitters at one level; the attached و of «وشعبة» is dropped.
One saying only: a man asks the Prophet about jihad; the Companion is the last link.
